items.heading: Jollof Rice
details: Key ingredients: rice, tomato, pepper, onion, spices
Blend tomato, pepper and onion into a smooth base.
Fry the blended base until it darkens and the oil separates.
Add rice and stock, stirring to coat the grains.
Cover and cook on low heat until the rice is tender and infused with flavor.

items.heading: Waakye
details: Key ingredients: rice, black-eyed peas, sorghum leaves, stew
Cook rice and black-eyed peas together with dried sorghum leaves for color.
Prepare a spicy tomato and pepper stew separately.
Fry plantain or add boiled egg and gari as sides.
Serve the reddish rice and beans with the stew and accompaniments.

items.heading: Fufu
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
